name: SocialJet – Social Media Auto Poster & Scheduler
author: Yusif Mammadov

sections.description:
SocialJet is a social media auto poster and scheduler for WordPress. It automatically shares your posts to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, Telegram, and Pinterest. It allows you to schedule posts on a weekly basis, set specific sharing times, and manage multiple accounts and pages. With a user-friendly React-based interface, SocialJet simplifies social media management for bloggers and businesses.

Features:

  • Schedules: share a chosen set of posts on a weekly plan, at fixed times or with a gap between posts, in order or at random
  • Auto-posters: share new posts automatically as they are published, filtered by post type, categories, tags and other taxonomies, author, featured image, title keywords and password protection
  • Post templates per account: text only, single image, gallery or link card
  • Connect several accounts, Pages, organizations, boards and channels per network, using your own developer app
  • Sharing history with the result of every post
  • Extensible: other plugins can add their own pages, settings, social networks and post text tags to the SocialJet screen with the SocialJet SDK

External services

SocialJet publishes your posts to third-party social networks on your behalf. A network is contacted only after you connect an account for it, and only to (a) authorize that account or (b) publish or schedule a post to it. In every case the data sent is limited to: your own app/client credentials and the requested OAuth scopes during authorization; the resulting access/refresh token on later requests; and your post content (text, links, and images) when publishing. Nothing is sent to any other destination.

Each network, what it is used for, the domains contacted, and its legal links are listed below.

Facebook and Instagram — Facebook Graph API (Meta Platforms, Inc.). Authorizes your account, lists the Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts you manage, and publishes posts and images. Domains contacted: facebook.com, graph.facebook.com.
Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms | Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Threads — Threads API (Meta Platforms, Inc.). Authorizes your account and publishes Threads posts. Domains contacted: threads.net, graph.threads.net.
Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms | Privacy Policy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy

LinkedIn — LinkedIn API (LinkedIn Corporation). Authorizes your account, lists the organization (Company) Pages you administer, uploads images, and publishes posts as a member or organization. Domains contacted: linkedin.com, api.linkedin.com.
Terms of Service: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement | Privacy Policy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy

Pinterest — Pinterest API v5 (Pinterest, Inc.). Authorizes your account, lists your boards, and publishes pins. Domains contacted: pinterest.com, api.pinterest.com.
Terms of Service: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service | Privacy Policy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy

Telegram — Telegram Bot API (Telegram Messenger Inc.). Publishes messages and media to the channels/groups served by your bot token. Domain contacted: api.telegram.org.
Terms of Service: https://telegram.org/tos | Privacy Policy: https://telegram.org/privacy

Development

Source code

SocialJet’s admin interface is built with React and TypeScript. The compiled, distribution-ready assets are bundled into the plugin’s /build folder. The full, human-readable source code for that interface is publicly available on GitHub:

https://github.com/yusifmov/socialjet-frontend

Build instructions

The interface also uses the SocialJet SDK, whose source code is public as well. Add-on developers use it to extend the SocialJet screen:

https://github.com/yusifmov/socialjet-sdk

The /build assets are generated from the source repository above. To reproduce them:

  1. Install Node.js (LTS) and npm.
  2. Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/yusifmov/socialjet-frontend
  3. Check out the tag that matches the plugin version, for example git checkout v1.0.11
  4. Install dependencies: npm install (this also installs the SocialJet SDK from GitHub)
  5. Build the production assets: npm run build
  6. Copy the generated build folder, including build/shared, into the plugin’s /build folder.

License

Both the bundled build assets and the source code in the repository above are licensed under GPLv3, the same license as the plugin itself.

Roadmap

Completed:
* Basic Facebook sharing (post title, link, and content)
* Weekly post scheduling
* Scheduling posts for a specific time
* Scheduling posts with a sharing gap
* Scheduling to multiple Facebook pages
* Sharing Queue menu (sharing history)
* Editing schedules
* Pausing and restarting schedules
* Post templates (text only, single image, gallery, link card)
* Meta pack: Facebook, Threads, and Instagram
* Telegram
* LinkedIn and Pinterest
* Auto-posting new posts (auto-posters)
* SDK for building add-ons
* UI/UX improvements

Planned:
* Additional post text tags
* X (Twitter)
* Blogging pack: Tumblr, Reddit, Mastodon, Blogger
* Google Business Profiles integration
* Russian pack: VKontakte, Odnoklassniki
* Discord integration
sections.installation:
1. Upload the socialjet folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the SocialJet settings page to configure your social media accounts and scheduling preferences.
sections.faq:
Which social networks are supported?

SocialJet currently supports Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, Telegram, and Pinterest. Support for additional platforms is planned for future updates.

Do I need my own developer app to connect an account?

Yes. For each network you provide your own app credentials (for example a client/app ID and secret). The plugin uses those credentials to authorize and post on your behalf through the network’s official API.
sections.changelog:
1.0.11

  • Auto-posters: share new posts automatically when they match filters (post type, categories, tags and other taxonomies, author, featured image, title keywords, password protection). Republishing a post shares it again
  • Fix: new posts are now detected when published from the block editor, by scheduled publishing, WP-CLI and XML-RPC
  • Fix: schedules paused by deactivating the plugin resume when it is activated again
  • Fix: a post that is no longer published is not shared
  • Fix: planned schedules no longer give several posts the same time slot
  • Fix: a failing admin page no longer blanks the whole SocialJet screen
  • Fix: post template choices now update correctly when editing a schedule
  • Fix: removing the selected account tab in the schedule editor
  • App secrets and bot tokens are now masked while typing
  • Ask for confirmation before deleting schedules
  • Add-ons can now extend the SocialJet screen with their own React UI, using the SocialJet SDK
  • Clearer account connection dialogs with links to each network’s developer console
  • The admin screen loads as JavaScript modules: natively on WordPress 6.5+, with a built-in fallback on older versions (WordPress 5.0+ supported)
  • The admin screen remembers the open page across reloads
  • Accounts page: filter by network, see which accounts need reconnecting, clearer “Connect account” picker
  • Settings show a confirmation when saved
  • Schedule editor: post picker with filters for post type, category, publish date and sort order, plus paging and a “selected” view
  • Schedule editor: account picker with search and filters by network and account type
  • Schedule editor: clearer per-account settings layout and step-by-step flow
  • Refreshed admin colours to match the SocialJet logo, with a lighter sidebar that stays in place while the page scrolls
  • Updated plugin description and build instructions

1.0.10

  • New plugin icon, banner and admin menu icon
  • Admin menu icon now follows the admin color scheme
  • Facebook: connected Pages no longer expire after a couple of hours (long-lived tokens)
  • Random post order in schedules now works
  • Schedule time offset is now applied correctly
  • Deleting a schedule now stops its pending posts from being shared; sent posts stay in history
  • More reliable sharing queue processing
  • Instagram: posts without a featured image no longer fail
  • Fixed errors when a post template setting is missing

1.0.9

  • More social networks added: Pinterest

1.0.8

  • More social networks added: Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, and Telegram

1.0.7

  • Tested with WordPress 6.9
  • Prevent duplicate posts from being scheduled
  • Security fixes

1.0.6

  • Security fixes

1.0.5

  • Security fixes

1.0.4

  • Security fixes

1.0.3

  • Security fixes

1.0.2

  • Security fixes

1.0.1

  • Enable editing of scheduled posts
  • Add the ability to toggle schedule status (pause/resume)
  • Fix minor UI/UX issues for improved usability

1.0.0

  • Add basic Facebook sharing (post title, link, and content)
  • Enable weekly post scheduling
  • Allow scheduling posts for specific times
  • Add support for scheduling with time gaps
  • Enable scheduling to multiple Facebook pages
